data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2018 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (1 Jan 2018) was GBP 523.82m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse movement on prior years of approximately GBP 17.54m (c.3.35% of opening reserves), driven by increases primarily in the 2016 and earlier underwriting years. This gross deterioration was more than offset on a net basis by favourable prior-year development after reinsurance (the report records net favourable prior year development of GBP 42.8m), reflecting strong reinsurance recoveries and favourable attritional development and limited catastrophe activity in 2018.
raw_causal_phrases: benign year and an element of favourable prior year development, notably on Political Risks & Political Violence

The decrease in the net loss ratio to 51.8% (2017: 67.2%) reflects a benign period of catastrophe events (compared to 2017 hurricane impact), with an element of favourable prior year development on attritional losses.

The impact of the 2018 hurricanes and wildfires was marginal, being contained within planned loss ratios.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development was computed from the gross claims development triangle (gross, GBP '000) because the explicit prior-year movement note in the accounts reports only net (after reinsurance) prior-year development. The triangle is presented in GBP '000 in the note; conversions to millions were applied. LOB-level prior year movements provided in the notes are net of reinsurance; those net amounts were included in lob_movements but flagged with lower confidence. No individual named catastrophe events (by hurricane name) were provided in the text. The triangle appears not to be distorted by RITC entries per the notes available.
